title: The Aileen Wuornos Serial Murders
evidence: Victims' vehicles and personal property were recovered
Items belonging to victims were pawned or disposed of by Wuornos
Ballistic evidence connected the murders to Wuornos
Wuornos was convicted of multiple first-degree murders
modus_operandi: Wuornos encountered male victims while working as a sex worker, entered their vehicles or traveled with them, and shot them. Victims' property and vehicles were subsequently taken, pawned, or disposed of.
personality_disorder: Forensic assessments documented Borderline Personality Disorder and Antisocial Personality Disorder. A later forensic study involving a clinical evaluation also found a high level of psychopathy, with a reported PCL-R score of 32.
summary: American serial killer convicted of murdering seven men. Her case is important for forensic psychology because clinical and forensic evaluations identified both borderline and antisocial personality pathology, while later research found substantial psychopathic characteristics.
